<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <title>Preprint Viewer</title>
    <style>
        body, html { margin: 0; padding: 0; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; font-family: sans-serif; }
        #viewer { width: 100%; height: 90vh; border: none; }
        footer { height: 10vh; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #f9f9f9; border-top: 1px solid #ddd; font-size: 14px; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <iframe id="viewer" src="Viles-Preprint-Manuscript.pdf"></iframe>
    <footer>
        <span>This work is licensed under a <a href="https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/" target="_blank">CC BY 4.0 License</a>.</span>
    </footer>
</body>
</html>
